narrationTexts: Confirms the plan. Now migrating each application file (skipping the vendored adapter, which is explicitly marked do-not-edit).
finalText:
**Migration done.** 12 files moved from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`:

`couponService.js`, `returnService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `teamService.js`, `cohort.js`, `shipment.js`, `supplier.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `refund.js`, `session.js`

One holdout left, `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9)`. Its header says it's replaced wholesale on every vendor upgrade and local edits get lost, so I left it alone.

Next: decide how to handle that vendored file, since it'll keep calling the deprecated `query` until the vendor package itself updates.
